title: Spatial arrangement of functional domains in OxyS stress response sRNA.
authors: Stih, Vesna; Amenitsch, Heinz; Plavec, Janez; Podbevsek, Peter
one_liner_zh: 该文通过NMR、SAXS和分子动力学模拟研究OxyS sRNA的结构及其与fhlA mRNA的碱基配对，属于RNA-RNA互作而非蛋白质-DNA互作，但MD方法可迁移至TF-DNA体系。
abstract: Small noncoding RNAs are an important class of regulatory RNAs in bacteria, often regulating responses to changes in environmental conditions. OxyS is a 110 nt, stable, trans-encoded small RNA found in Escherichia coli and is induced by an increased concentration of hydrogen peroxide. OxyS has an important regulatory role in cell stress response, affecting the expression of multiple genes. In this work, we investigated the structure of OxyS and the interaction with fhlA mRNA using nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy, small-angle X-ray scattering, and unbiased molecular dynamics simulations. We determined the secondary structures of isolated stem-loops and confirmed their structural integrity in OxyS. Unexpectedly, stem-loop SL4 was identified in the region that was predicted to be unstructured. Three-dimensional models of OxyS demonstrate that OxyS adopts an extended structure with four solvent-exposed stem-loops, which are available for interaction with other RNAs and proteins. Furthermore, we provide evidence of base-pairing between OxyS and fhlA mRNA.
abstract_zh: 小非编码RNA是细菌中一类重要的调控RNA，通常调控对环境条件变化的响应。OxyS是一种110核苷酸、稳定、反式编码的小RNA，存在于大肠杆菌中，并由过氧化氢浓度升高诱导产生。OxyS在细胞应激反应中具有重要调控作用，影响多个基因的表达。在本工作中，我们利用核磁共振波谱、小角X射线散射和无偏分子动力学模拟研究了OxyS的结构及其与fhlA mRNA的相互作用。我们确定了分离茎环的二级结构，并确认了它们在OxyS中的结构完整性。出乎意料的是，茎环SL4被鉴定在预测为无结构的区域中。OxyS的三维模型表明，OxyS采用延伸结构，具有四个溶剂暴露的茎环，这些茎环可用于与其他RNA和蛋白质相互作用。此外，我们提供了OxyS与fhlA mRNA之间碱基配对的证据。
